Customs Act 1969: This act provides the enabling authority under Section 21(b) for the National Board of Revenue to issue amendments to customs notifications.
Value Added Tax Act 1991: Section 14(2) of this act is cited as a source of regulatory power for the National Board of Revenue to amend previous customs-related orders.
National Board of Revenue: The board is the authority responsible for issuing and amending customs-related regulatory orders under the power granted by the relevant tax and customs laws.
S.R.O. 143-AIN/2009: This notification is formally amended by the current order regarding specific tariff headings and H.S. Code classifications.
TABLE-1: This table is amended by replacing specific headings and corresponding entries related to chemical substances, specifically aluminium phosphide and zinc phosphide, and updating an H.S. Code for alkaloids.
TABLE-2: This table is amended by correcting H.S. Codes for organic surface-active agents and specific chemical products to ensure accurate classification.
H.S. Code: The order performs specific administrative corrections to various H.S. Codes within the tariff structure to align with updated classifications.
